newsitem.title: USA: Stocks end mixed, blue chips little changed.
newsitem.headline: Stocks end mixed, blue chips little changed.

text.p: Stocks turned in a mixed performance on Friday, with technology stocks suffering heavy losses and blue chips ending little changed.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 4.24 points, or 0.06 percent, at 6,931.62, based on early, unofficial results. On Thursday, it fell 92.75 points, two days after closing at a record high of 7,067.46.
In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 13-11 on active volume of 481 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
